snippet.title: 🔥 Durga – Official Game Announcement Teaser 🔥
snippet.description:
From the creators of Shivaansh ArtVision comes a tale rooted in myth, courage, and heritage.

Lets step into the world of Durga, 🦁 a fearless village girl thrust into an unforgettable journey of survival and self-discovery. Explore a rich, story-driven RPG experience where puzzles meet adventure in the heart of ancient Indian forests. 🌳✨

📜 Unravel timeless Indian folklore
🐾 Confront wild beasts and hidden dangers
🌟 Witness Durga’s rise from brave villager to cultural guardian

🎮 An original Indian indie game crafted with heart, soul, and myth.

🔔 Subscribe and hit the bell to follow Durga’s journey and upcoming updates!
📲 Follow us on social media:
Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3598280/Durga__The_Lionhearted/
